# Proddigia

> Proddigia is an exclusive real estate agency specializing in property sales and rentals across Barcelona and the surrounding region.

Proddigia has been operating since 2008, offering comprehensive real estate services including property listings, valuations, virtual tours, and home staging. The agency serves the Barcelona metropolitan area with offices in Barcelona and Sant Cugat, providing services in Spanish, Catalan, and English.

## Key Topics

- Real Estate Agency

## Property Marketplace

- [Inmuebles en venta](https://proddigia.com/venta): Property search and listings for sale in Barcelona region with advanced filters
- [Inmuebles en alquiler](https://proddigia.com/alquiler): Rental property marketplace with optimized search for Barcelona area apartments
- [Vende tu propiedad con nosotros con seguridad](https://proddigia.com/vender-piso): Property selling guide with valuation and virtual tour technology for Barcelona
